text:
Done — I refreshed the UI and split the front-end JavaScript into smaller files without changing the app’s behavior.

What I changed:
- Gave the app a more modern look:
  - softer gradient background
  - glassy sticky header
  - larger rounded cards and inputs
  - improved spacing, focus states, and button styling
- Split the inline page scripts into separate files:
  - `public/scripts/index.js`
  - `public/scripts/login.js`
  - `public/scripts/signup.js`
  - `public/scripts/post.js`
  - `public/scripts/profile.js`
- Kept shared helpers in `public/common.js`
- Simplified `src/server.js` a bit while preserving routes and behavior
- Updated the HTML pages to load the new script files

Note:
- I didn’t change any app functionality.
- I couldn’t fully run the server in this container because dependencies aren’t installed here, but the code changes were made consistently across the project.
